syllabus_topics: Feedback and Stability. Linear two-ports. Feedback topologies. Stability as a function of return gain. Nyquist diagram. Effect on frequency response.
Analog Filters. Design of Butterworth and Chebyshev filters. Frequency transformations. Realization of active filters by direct simulation (GIC). Biquadratic sections.
Oscillators. Barkhausen criterion. Stability of oscillation frequency and amplitude. Oscillator circuits: Wien bridge, phase shift, LC and relaxation. Applications.
Digital Filters. Signal digitalization. IIR and FIR filters. Realization of digital filters.
Digital Systems. ROM, EPROM, EEPROM, SRAM and DRAM memories.

Embedded Systems. Electronics of embedded systems: interface between microcontrollers and external components. Bluetooth, ZigBee, Wi-Fi and IoT. Design, implementation and testing of advanced embedded electronic systems.

assessment_methods.method: Final Exam, Resit Exam, or Special Season Exam (best grade counted as Nexame)
Laboratory work (3 assignments: Feedback, Proximity Detector, Microcontroller)

assessment_rules: The final grade (NF) is calculated as 0.5 * Nlab + 0.5 * Nexame, rounded to the nearest unit. Nexame is the best grade among the Final Exam, Resit Exam, or Special Season Exam, with a minimum score of 8.0. Nlab is the average of the 3 laboratory reports, rounded to the first decimal, and must be greater than or equal to 9.5. Mandatory attendance for all laboratory sessions; absence from a demonstration results in a zero for that work. All students must obtain approval in the laboratory component for all assessment methods.
